variants.headline: Still in view: accident at a workplace
variants.sub: The colony has had an accident at a workplace.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}.

We criticise {target} on the standard of safety stewardship. An accident warrants serious questions about responsibility, rather than a comfortable presumption that the conduct surrounding work should remain beyond public judgment.

variants.sub: A workplace in the colony has been the scene of an accident.
